items.summary: What to do if your flight was cancelled or delayed by the FAA's national ground stop on Friday

items.title: FAA lifts ground stop flights, airline stocks fall
items.summary: Airline stocks fell right before Friday's close after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ordered a nationwide ground stop. Departing flights cannot take off, while flights already in the air may continue to their destination.

items.title: United, Other Airline Stocks Drop After Nationwide Flight Ground Stop. Rental Car Stocks Rise.
items.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the stoppage was due to “a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers. FAA technicians are investigating the issue.”

items.title: FAA Grounds All Flights Nationwide
items.summary: The FAA ordered all flights across the country to remain grounded.

items.title: FAA Grounds All Flights Nationwide
items.summary: All flights in the US have been grounded. The Federal Aviation Administration cited "extraordinary circumstances" and "reasons of safety" for the ground stop, which affects all US airports. Bloomberg's Will Guisbond is following this breaking news.

items.title: Airline Stocks Drop After FAA Temporarily Halts Flights
items.summary: Airline stocks ticked lower this afternoon and fell further in postmarket trading following the Federal Aviation Administration’s decision to halt flight departures nationwide.

items.title: SPCE Stock Alert: What to Know as Virgin Galactic Raises Ticket Prices to $850K
items.summary: Virgin Galactic announces limited seats at a higher price of $850,000. But does that warrant buying SPCE shares today? Let’s find out!
